name: part-suppression-marks-nothing
description: A suppression for a part of a declaration withholds the part's finding and marks nothing. Two functions nothing calls each never read their parameter, and each carries an inline directive for the parameter's code alone: above the function where the parameter is declared on the function's first line, and above the parameter inside a wrapped parameter list. Each function is still reported as dead, each parameter's finding is withheld, and neither directive is stale.
